FAQ

What exactly do you deliver?

An operational system: customer handling, follow‑ups, consistent messaging, and team docs.

Does my team need to be technical?

No. You provide business info, I make it simple and train your team.

How about privacy?

Minimal collection, tiered access; sensitive data via field lists.

Who is this for?

For companies ready to improve customer experience and processes, not just a demo.

How long does it take to set up the customer service system?

The 30-day implementation offer focuses on a customer service and follow-up system your team can take over. The scope and timeline depend on your business, team size, and language needs.

How much does AI consulting cost?

Pricing depends on scope, business volume, team size, and the languages you need to support. The first conversation helps define what your business does and which problem to address first.
